unit.reason: Needs the sibling plugin wp-content/plugins/ohmylms-custom-question, which is not in this repository.
Helpers, not suites: tests/js/ui-button.test.mjs and tests/js/ui-components.test.mjs call them with a JSON argument (npm test).

integration.reason: Needs the disposable site from tools/create-test-site.py: OHMYLMS_TEST_CREDENTIALS, OHMYLMS_TEST_SITE, a database named ohmylms_source_test imported from the baseline, and the sibling ohmylms-qpay and ohmylms-custom-question plugins. The *-http suites and mcp-integration also make real HTTP or AI requests.

Refuse to run unless DB_NAME is the dedicated migration database ohmylms_gutenberg_migration_20261020 (native-quiz-editor also accepts ohmylms_block_browser_1dea) with OHMYLMS_TEST_SITE; they check content migrated into that database.
Refuse to run unless DB_NAME is the isolated streak database ohmylms_streak_test with OHMYLMS_TEST_SITE (docs/GAMIFICATION-STREAKS.md).
Needs --local, OHMYLMS_TEST_PDFTOPPM (a pdftoppm binary) and the xyz.local host.

Pass on the Local site but need what a clean install lacks: a published course (course-carousel), source assets built into build/sdk with OHMYLMS_SOURCE_ASSETS on (extension-host-assets), enrolment sources from the Local roster (gradebook-rest), a teaching syllabus with objectives (lesson-settings), the ohmylms-graded-reader plugin, which is not in this repository (questions-rest), and shared skills placed on the site (skill-workspace-rest). Skipped only in CI.

Not suites: prefix-migration renames database tables when given --apply; randomized-preview-readonly is the PHP half of tests/js/randomized-preview.test.mjs, which the integration job runs with OHMYLMS_READONLY_WP_ROOT.

Fail at HEAD (31 October 2026) on the Local site and on a clean install. They run and must still fail; the runner reports one that passes so its entry can be removed. Assertions: course-outline 'Lesson references are remapped while preserving their UUID'; course-structure 'Shared view preserves empty units, canonical order, group and placement IDs'; learner-journey 'The lesson includes its reading, video/reading and practice in published order'; student-directory 'Non-student leaked into directory'; subject-profiles 'A stale revision is refused'; subjects 'Visitors can start either course through its enrollment overview'; prefix-integration calls the retired ohmylms/v1/membership route (memberships-rest-integration covers ohmylms/v1/memberships).
